environment.description: Same application container image deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL with the following rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) Priority 100 — AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule action override set to COUNT (not block), (2) Priority 200 — a custom rule 'query-param-length-cap' using ByteMatchStatement on UriPath=/api/users/search with a SizeConstraintStatement on SingleQueryArgument 'q' with ComparisonOperator GT and Size 64, action BLOCK, (3) Priority 300 — AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with NO rule action overrides (all rules in default BLOCK mode including SQLi_QUERYARGUMENTS which inspects all query string parameters using the built-in SQLi detection engine with sensitivity level HIGH). The WebACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics confirm both rule groups are actively evaluating traffic.

rules.name: query-param-length-cap
rules.statement: SizeConstraint on SingleQueryArgument 'q' > 64 bytes when UriPath starts with /api/users/search
